profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Genesys IVR & Routing Specialist | Cloud & API Integration
profile.jobTitle: Full Stack Developer / Genesys IVR & Routing  Developer
profile.summary:
Dedicated and highly organized IT Professional with more than 9 years of experience specializing in systems analysis, full-stack software development, and Genesys IVR & routing solutions. Throughout my career, I have successfully adapted to diverse roles, technologies, and project requirements, consistently delivering assignments on time and with high quality.
Driven by a proactive mindset and strong interpersonal skills, I excel at driving results in collaborative environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, and Kanban. I am passionate about solving complex technical challenges, embracing new technologies, and acting as a reliable technical backbone for growing teams.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer / Genesys IVR & Routing  Developer
positions.description: Senior Systems Engineer specializing in the end-to-end architecture, development, and deployment of enterprise voice and contact center solutions. Proven track record of implementing high-availability Genesys Frameworks, including GVP (IVR), Outbound Solutions, and seamless CTI/Softphone integrations. Adept at translating complex business logic into scalable, robust voice infrastructure that enhances agent performance and customer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Genesys Cloud · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kanban · Agile Methodologies · Elasticsearch

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Full-Stack Developer and Web Operations Specialist experienced in orchestrating seamless website and database migrations. Proven track record managing complex DNS configurations, domain verifications, and custom SSL implementations to secure enterprise portals. Adept at launching and configuring Shopify environments, including advanced technical setups like Meta (Facebook) Pixel integration. Builds and maintains custom internal tools using PHP to optimize corporate workflows and automate routine maintenance.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · SQL · HTML5 · Software Development · MySQL · WordPress · PHP Frameworks · JavaScript · PSD to Wordpress · Server Administration

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
* Development of web projects of professionals and companies that need to have an Internet presence.
* Design and implementation of customized applications and / or services according to the needs of the client and its users.
* Research of best practices for the development and implementation of systems.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · SQL · HTML5 · Software Development · WordPress · PHP Frameworks · JSON · JavaScript · PSD to Wordpress

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Database coordinator and developer in Oracle 11g architecture. Development and integration of services in Java projects. Maintenance for the Mi Movistar self-management application (http://www.mi.movistar.com.ve/)
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle SQL Developer · Java Enterprise Edition · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Account management and project leader. Analysis, design and development of web applications. Maintenance of web applications and integration of third-party components (Telerik, Sencha, Jquery Plugin's). Basic Mobile application development. Platform .NET
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · HTML5 · Software Development · JSON

positions.title: Developer II
positions.description: Maintenance service for web applications developed in projects. Integrations modules for sending sms, mail and calls. Components used Java EE, Struts, EJB, JSP, MySQL, JQuery, Glassfish, Platform Java.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) · HTML5 · Software Development · Java

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed production and maintained web application using HTML, SQL and RUBY ON RAILS. The purpose of this app was to make available to the university community the faculties academic offer through the Internet, so that students can explore and take subjects of other careers
